visual_review: Before had no today line: three stacked blobby boxes with pinhole cells, plus a stray connector between bars 2 and 3, reading as a stack of plugs. Now three staggered rounded bars carry progress dividers, and a vertical today line runs from the top through bars B and C, as in the reference.
omissions: The line's overshoot below the last bar, and bar C's separate divider (the today line divides it).
